name: Docusign
summary: Electronic signature and agreement management. Its first-party MCP server exposes 24 tools in its public catalog (22 over envelopes, recipients, templates, users, workflows and agreements, plus two read-only "skill" tools that instruct the calling model): create an envelope, set signers and their routing order, read envelope and recipient status, remind pending signers, and void. The catalog is published without credentials at mcp.docusign.com/tools; the endpoint answers 401 with an OAuth challenge, and the vendor accepts Confidential Authorization Code Grant or JWT Grant tokens.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-11-12 06:07Z, no credentials: POST mcp.docusign.com/mcp answers 401 with a Bearer challenge naming the root resource metadata (403, no challenge, through 09-27); six scopes; GET /tools serves 24 tools. Grants: Auth Code or JWT. Production IK needs GA allow-listing (2026-09-30).

jobs.summary: The vendor's published MCP tool catalog, read without credentials: createEnvelope from a template or remote document, updateEnvelopeRecipients with a routingOrder per signer, getEnvelope and listRecipients for status, sendReminder to pending signers, updateEnvelope to send or void. Not executed.

payments.notes: Read 2026-09-18, re-read 2026-09-27, unchanged: plans are bought on the vendor's checkout (Personal $11/month, Standard $30/user/month, Business Pro $45/user/month, annual commitments); the page names no payment method for the subscription. The MCP server has no price and speaks no 402 protocol.
